question: According to the Internal Displacement Monitoring Centre report, between 2015 and 2024, how many internal displacements due to disasters were recorded in India?
solution: The correct answer is __**32.3 million**__. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** • The **Internal Displacement Monitoring Centre (IDMC)** report highlights the extent of internal displacements caused by disasters across the globe, including in India. • Between **2015 and 2024**, India recorded approximately **32.3 million internal displacements** caused by disasters such as floods, cyclones, and other natural events. • India is one of the most disaster-prone countries due to its **geographical location and climatic conditions**, which expose it to frequent natural calamities. • Disasters such as **floods, cyclones, landslides, and droughts** are the primary causes of these displacements, significantly impacting vulnerable populations and communities. • According to the report, internal displacement often leads to **loss of livelihoods, social dislocation, and economic instability**, creating long-term challenges for the affected individuals and the country.
